component.label: cloud,cloud

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelIbmSecretsManagerProducerOperation.label: producer
CamelIbmSecretsManagerProducerOperation.description: Overrides the desired operation to be used in the producer.

CamelIbmSecretsManagerSecretName.label: producer
CamelIbmSecretsManagerSecretName.description: Set the desired secret name as header.

CamelIbmSecretsManagerSecretVersion.label: producer
CamelIbmSecretsManagerSecretVersion.description: Set the desired secret version as header.

CamelIbmSecretsManagerSecretId.label: producer
CamelIbmSecretsManagerSecretId.description: Set the desired secret ID as header.

CamelIbmSecretsManagerSecretPayload.label: producer
CamelIbmSecretsManagerSecretPayload.description: Set the secret payload for update operation.

CamelIbmSecretsManagerSecretData.label: producer
CamelIbmSecretsManagerSecretData.description: Set the secret data (Map) for KV secret update operation.

producerIn.description: The payload of the secret for createArbitrarySecret, the default operation, as text: bytes, a stream or a file are read as text, a Map or a POJO is stored as its toString(), and no body fails. createKVSecret needs a Map of the keys and values: a JSON text fails, so unmarshal it first. updateSecret takes text for an arbitrary secret and a Map for a kv secret, unless the CamelIbmSecretsManagerSecretPayload or CamelIbmSecretsManagerSecretData header is set. The other operations take the secret id from a header

producerOut.description: The id of the new secret for createArbitrarySecret and createKVSecret. getSecret gives the payload text of an arbitrary secret, the Map of a kv secret, or the Secret of the IBM SDK for service credentials, and fails for other secret types. updateSecret gives the SecretVersion of the IBM SDK, the list operations the collection of the IBM SDK, and deleteSecret leaves the body unchanged
